findings.text: §6's EQDB transport "gains one request type and one record type ... rather than widening the channel types" and keeps "the per-request refusal contract", but `ChannelRefusal` (`imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py:101`) is keyed `(shot, category, dname)` while an EQDB request names a shot and an equilibrium record and "its request and record are not channels", so the existing refusal shape cannot represent an EQDB refusal without a second refusal type; the section does not say whether it reuses `ChannelRefusal` under a synthetic category/dname or adds a refusal family
